title: Variational Shadow Runner for Calibration & Accuracy Gate
creator: Ethan Liu
description:
Objective: build an automated accuracy validation harness ("Shadow Runner") that executes quantized model variants (FP8/INT8) in shadow mode against a float32 baseline and emits per-cohort pass/fail decisions used for CI gating and runtime rollouts.

Scope: harness must: 1) orchestrate deterministic replay and stochastic-sampled evaluations, 2) evaluate across stratified golden prompt cohorts (NLU/QA/code/longform/short-context), 3) compute a multi-metric fidelity score (token-level delta log-likelihood, normalized edit-distance, embedding cosine similarity, structural matcher for function/call outputs), 4) support adversarial perturbation and temporal drift checks, 5) run as a GitHub Actions/Buildkite job and as a daily scheduled job that populates the Console dashboard and alerts.

Why now: we are increasing FP8 and mixed-precision rollouts across Dedicated and Private customers; without a robust, automated acceptance gate we risk regressions that only appear in production cohorts. The Shadow Runner will be the canonical acceptance harness used by quant calibration pipelines and runtime rollout policies.

Design highlights: 1) Variational probes: for each golden prompt run a deterministic seed (for baseline comparability) plus K stochastic perturbations (temperature/sampling) to capture distributional fidelity; 2) Cohort-weighted gating: compute per-cohort scores and an overall weighted pass/fail, with ability to promote specific cohort importance per customer/region; 3) Metric ensemble: thresholds for each metric (configurable) plus an aggregated score with explainability traces; 4) Canary vs full-run modes: fast, lower-sample canary run for PR blocking, heavier nightly run for release acceptance and trend analysis; 5) Telemetry: collect per-token latency, memory, KV-cache-hit delta, and token-generation divergence to tie accuracy regressions to perf changes.

Acceptance gate policy (initial): pass if all three hold: (A) aggregate weighted fidelity >= 0.92, (B) max per-cohort embedding cosine >= 0.985 on average (or no cohort drop > 0.010), (C) average delta log-likelihood <= 0.12 nats/token. Failing samples should return top-5 counterexamples (input + baseline + quantized outputs) for triage. Gates will be configurable per-release in a YAML manifest.

Artifacts & storage: run outputs (raw tokens, logits, embeddings, metrics, diff snapshots) written to s3://redwood-quant-validation/{run_id}/. Golden sets versioned in GS:gs://redwood-goldens/quant-v2/ with cohort manifests. All runs create artifacts and a summarizing JSON that Console can ingest.

Operational notes: 1) integrate with existing calibration orchestrator to invoke shadow runs post-calibration candidate generation, 2) expose API for on-demand runs from Console, 3) health signals: if nightly run consistently fails the same cohort for 3 days mark regression and create an incident ticket.

Security & PII: golden prompts must be scrubbed for customer PII; ensure golden set maintainers sign off and that run artifacts respect KMS encryption and access policies.

Trade-offs discussed: running full deterministic replay with logits is expensive (S3 + compute). Proposal is tiered retention: keep full raw artifacts for failed runs for 30d, aggregated metrics retained 1y. For canary/PR runs use sampled K=3 perturbations; nightly full-run uses K=25.

Runbook summary: how to triage a failed gate, dashboard locations, and quick commands to replay a failure locally (rb script: tools/quant_shadow/replay.sh --run {run_id}).
acceptance_criteria: Shadow Runner can execute FP8 and INT8 variants against float32 baseline and produce comparable artifact bundles in s3
GitHub Actions job created that blocks runtime-1.18 merges on canary failures (configurable gate)
Console dashboard tile renders per-cohort fidelity trends and links to top counterexamples
Configurable YAML manifest supports cohort weights and metric thresholds
Nightly scheduled job runs full-run K=25 and stores full artifacts for failed runs
progress_updates: 2025-02-18 - Spike complete: validated feasibility of deterministic replay by extending existing replay harness (ENG-314159) to capture logits and embeddings at token granularity. Prototype runs for a small golden subset (50 prompts) completed.

2025-02-23 - Implemented metrics pipeline: token-delta logp, edit-distance, sentence-embedding cosine (using SentenceTransformers), and structural matcher for tool-calling outputs. Initial thresholds proposed in design doc.
2025-02-28 - PR #3417 opened (github.com/redwood-inference/quant-validation/pull/3417) with canary-mode runner; awaiting security review on artifact encryption and golden-set scrub checklist.
2025-03-01 - Design review with PM/DS: agreed on cohort stratification, canary vs nightly mode, and retention policy. Action: dataset team to curate adversarial cohort by 2025-03-07 (blocked).
2025-03-03 - Integrated basic Console ingestion endpoint; dashboard prototype at https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/quant-shadow/overview showing toy run metrics.
